claim: cemsusbregsiter produces the Region A pointer in legacy EDPF metadata but its CDiskFile ReadSectorData/WriteSectorData call graph contains no six-sector I/O to that Region A extent.
facts: sub_10040110 computes the Region A byte location CHS_bytes - 0xE0000; CreatePartitions converts it to a sector number and stores it in legacy EDPF entries.
sub_10014da0 serializes the 3x0x40 legacy table plus metadata into the LBA7 label-sector buffer; it does not dereference EDPF StartSector for device I/O.

Every direct sub_100136c0/sub_10013810 call in this decompilation was enumerated. The observed transfer counts are label/backup ranges such as 1, 9, 0x0d, 0x20, 0x22 sectors or variable actual-partition operations; no call is the Region A six-sector extent at CHS-0x700.
sub_10040940 is BakupUsbSec and backs up front label sectors near another CHS-tail backup area; it is not Region A I/O.
sub_10013e40 only builds an in-memory 0x200-byte structure with 0x55AA tail and performs no disk I/O.
proves: cemsusbregsiter is a proven producer of the Region A pointer metadata, not yet a proven producer of the 0xC00 Region A payload.
The actual Region A payload producer/consumer must be sought in another call path/module or an I/O mechanism outside this DLL's enumerated CDiskFile sector wrappers.
limitations: This is a bounded negative result for the analyzed cemsusbregsiter.dll build; it does not rule out another binary/version or a non-CDiskFile I/O mechanism.
